Bike Newport Full Moon Ride

Newport, RI · Broadway · Social

Bike Newport Full Moon Ride is a social group ride in Newport, RI. Schedule: Monthly on or near the full moon, April through October. Gather 30 minutes before a sunset-timed start (Sep 26, 2026: gather 4:55 pm, roll 5:25 pm), from Equality Park.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:25 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.

Pace: casual.
Check
Look at @bikenewportri the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike Newport Full Moon Ride group ride

A monthly evening ride from Equality Park on Broadway. The 15-mile loop goes out to Green Bridge, around part of Ocean Drive, and back along Coggeshall. Start times shift with the sunset, so check the date list. Registration is through Eventbrite.
